entities.summary: Hà Tiên is a provincial city in An Giang Province, Mekong Delta in Vietnam. Its area is 10,049 ha and the population as of 2019 is 81,576. The city borders Cambodia to the west. Hà Tiên is a tourist site of the region thanks to its beaches and landscapes.
